meta.title: Decision Guard
meta.description: Sensitive-command approval plus on-demand tool loading, skill selection, and glob ranking driven by one decision model.

select.selectToolsEnabledHelp: Off by default. When on, each conversation first judges which tools fit the task and hides the rest for now, saving the tokens the tool list would cost. Hidden tools can be found again with tool_search.
select.selectWhitelistHelp: Comma-separated tool names that are never hidden. A baseline set (lookup, read/write, search) is built in; entries here are added to it.
select.selectMinProbabilityHelp: Between 0 and 1. Tools judged above it are kept; a higher value hides more. Defaults to 0.5.
select.selectStatsNone: Nothing is hidden; the tool list is complete.
select.selectRestoreConfirm: Restore every tool hidden in any session? Only the hiding is undone; the settings above stay.
select.selectSkillsEnabledHelp: Off by default. Each session judges which skills are worth keeping: those above the threshold and within the limit stay in the catalog; the rest go to an on-demand pool. Re-judged only when the skill set changes, so the catalog stays stable across turns. The model can list the pool with skill_catalog and load any skill by name.
select.selectSkillLimitHelp: 1-20, default 8. A maximum only: qualifying skills are kept by relevance, never padded; the overflow goes to the on-demand pool.
select.selectSkillMinProbabilityHelp: 0-1, default 0.5. Skills below this probability leave the catalog and join the on-demand pool. If none qualify, the catalog is empty and points to skill_catalog.
select.selectFilesEnabledHelp: Off by default. When on, paths returned by glob are ranked by relevance to the task, relevant ones first. No path is ever dropped.
select.selectFileCandidatesHelp: 1-200, default 40. More candidates than this and the results come back unchanged, sparing a model round trip.
select.selectUnavailable: Could not read the on-demand settings: {msg}
select.selectUnavailableHelp: This tab needs the backend /sensitive-guard/api/select endpoint. While it is missing you keep seeing this note; restart DSH after updating the plugin.
